summary: simonw/llm uses openai for Chat, Responses, legacy completions, embeddings, model listing; also OpenAI-compatible endpoints via api_base through openai >3 in 13 places; user-supplied-urls for Fetch fragments, templates and attachments from arbitrary user URLs through raw HTTP in 4 places; openai for List models through raw HTTP, pinned to /v1/models in 1 place.
agentSummary:
I found two external APIs in the repo: OpenAI, and arbitrary user-supplied URLs. I read only the call sites I recorded and skimmed nothing else, so a missed call site is possible. All the line numbers were checked by `record_usage`.

- **OpenAI through the `openai` SDK**
  - **Where:** `llm/default_plugins/openai_models.py`.
  - **What it calls:** chat completions (sync and async), the Responses API (sync and async, streaming and not), legacy completions, embeddings and `models.list`.
  - **Client setup:** the client is built in `get_client`. It sets `base_url` from `api_base`, so the same code serves custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints. The SDK is declared as `openai>3`, and there is no lockfile, so no resolved version.
- **OpenAI through raw HTTP:** `GET https://api.openai.com/v1/models` at line 878 of the same file, with a Bearer key. It is the "list models" command. `/v1/` is the only version pinned.
- **User-supplied URLs through `httpx2`:** the code fetches whatever URL the user gives it, so there is no fixed host.
  - `llm/cli.py` lines 275 and 4368 fetch fragments and templates.
  - `llm/models.py` lines 96 and 111 fetch attachments.

I recorded the last group under the made-up provider id `user-supplied-urls`. It isn't a vendor, so you may want to treat it differently from the other two.

I didn't record the `example.test` and `localai.localhost` hosts, which appear only in tests. The other hosts the scanner listed (GitHub, docs links, sqlite.org) are docs, comments or metadata, not calls the code makes. I found no webhooks, no GraphQL and no other SDKs. Plugins for other providers live outside this repo.

I didn't read the `tests/cassettes` files or the docs beyond what the scanner surfaced.
